title: Create WebeWizard personal website on GitHub Pages
request: Create a polished personal website for WebeWizard with bio and about content only, hosted from this repository using the default GitHub Pages project URL. Create a new GitHub repository named webe-website and commit and push this repository. Propose the visual design; do not invent personal facts. Repository visibility and public release approval remain unresolved.
acceptanceCriteria: The website identifies WebeWizard and contains bio and about content only; no invented personal facts or private information are published.
The website is responsive at 320px and desktop widths, keyboard navigable, and uses readable accessible contrast.
Website assets work under the /webe-website/ project path and a GitHub Pages workflow publishes only the website artifact after explicit resident publication approval.
The new webe-website GitHub repository receives a verified initial push after its owner, visibility, and release scope are confirmed.
